title: Figure 30: fluid volume fraction contour on cut plane of disc-water simulation
description: ANSYS CFD result frame labeled 'Animated Result, Fluid 2 Volume Fraction' showing contour lines of water volume fraction on the cut plane as the disc interacts with the free surface. Color legend from 1.000e+000 to 1.000e-015 at left. From the BAASS simulation of a disc UAP at an air-water interface.
